greeting: Welcome to Lustre Beauty Studio. I can help you with appointments, beauty services, pricing, and opening hours. How may I assist you today?

booking_flow.lead_prompt: Certainly. I can help you book a beauty appointment. May I know your full name?

faqs.a: We offer hair styling, bridal grooming, facial treatment, threading and waxing, and manicure and pedicure services.
Pricing depends on the selected service and package. Our team can help confirm the best option for your visit.
Please notify the studio at least 2 hours before your appointment if you need to cancel or reschedule.

cancellation_policy: Please inform us at least 2 hours before your appointment if you need to cancel or reschedule.
pricing: Beauty service pricing varies by service and package, and can be confirmed during booking.
fallback: I can help with beauty services, pricing, appointment booking, and basic studio enquiries. What do you need help with?
